snippet.title: 👁️ PROJECT 14 | 4 Minutes of Gameplay | Puzzles, Choices & Exploration
snippet.description:
Take a closer look at Project 14 with four minutes of actual gameplay.

This gameplay preview offers a glimpse into the game's exploration, puzzles and environments. Make decisions, follow the system's instructions – or question them – and discover what happens when you explore beyond the obvious path.

Featuring the game's British system narrator, several player choices, hidden discoveries and a brief look at one of its unexpected bonus sequences.

About Project 14:

Project 14 is a short psychological puzzle game filled with bizarre tests, unconventional challenges, dark humour and unexpected twists.

Explore strange environments, uncover hidden secrets and discover how your actions influence the experience. Following the rules isn't always the best idea.

With alternative paths and multiple endings, there's more to discover than one playthrough might reveal.
